name: Ufa

queries.query: Ufa официальный публичная кадастровая карта земельные участки городская администрация геопортал Росреестр
queries.result: Официальный портал Управления земельных и имущественных отношений администрации Уфы публикует услуги по схемам земельных участков на кадастровом плане и материалы комплексных кадастровых работ. Росреестр сообщает, что публичная кадастровая карта находится на НСПД и доступна без входа. Векторный endpoint с безопасной проекцией полей не найден; границы и ID не запрашивались.

queries.query: Ufa Russia official cadastral public map city land registry parcels
queries.result: Ufa’s official land and property administration publishes city-specific land and cadastral procedures. Rosreestr confirms that its public cadastral map moved to NSPD and is available without authorization. No anonymous full-polygon service with a safe property projection was verified.

portals.observation: Rosreestr states that the Public Cadastral Map is on NSPD and available without authorization or payment.
Official Ufa land/property administration publishes city land procedures, cadastral works and land schemes.
Official municipal procedure concerns preparation/approval of Ufa land-plot schemes on cadastral plans/maps.
Official city notice documents current comprehensive cadastral work in Ufa.

verifiedParcelResponse.limitations: No public, anonymous full-polygon response with privacy-safe selected attributes was retrieved or retained.

source.name: Ufa city cadastral source review
source.operator: Russian Federal Service for State Registration, Cadastre and Cartography (Rosreestr), Bashkortostan and Ufa land-management authorities
source.format: Official public cadastral map/registry and municipal land records; no safe full-vector API verified
source.access: Public source and layer-metadata review only; no account login, owner search, address search, cadastral-key search, or feature identify query used.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official national public cadastral map applies to parcels within Ufa; city sources confirm land/cadastral administration.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public registry/map activity is confirmed, but anonymous privacy-safe full polygon retrieval is not verified.

registryBasis: The national EGRN public cadastral map is delivered through NSPD; Ufa’s official Administration land and property office handles city land schemes and cadastral work. No public feature service with a privacy-safe geometry/ID schema was established.
technicalBlocker: The NSPD public map is officially documented as anonymous, but no safe vector feature schema was verified. Direct shell attempts to load the map timed out in this environment; that is not evidence of origin failure.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a documented anonymous feature route can return full geometry with only safe native parcel identifiers is unresolved; the WUP point is not matched to any parcel.
nextStep: If further research is warranted, use a documented public feature service only after confirming a property-safe field projection; never use identify/cédula/search functions that expose owner, address or tax data.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
scopeLimits: Source discovery only. No owner/address/property value or account data retained; no parcel-level lookup or geometry was performed.
